items.title: OpenTelemetry Makes Kubernetes Attributes Processor Stable as Observability Schema Matures
items.blurb: OpenTelemetry has promoted its Kubernetes Attributes Processor to v1.0.0, marking a significant step in making Kubernetes telemetry more predictable and stable across observability pipelines. By Craig Risi

items.title: Scaling Kubernetes Workloads with Node Swap
items.blurb: Memory is often the first hard limit a Kubernetes cluster hits. Nodes run out of RAM long before they run out of CPU, and the new wave of agentic AI workloads makes this worse.
